findings.location: task.hints[0].blocks[0].text and task.feedback.incorrectUk: «План має конкретний час і звучить як уже вирішене.»; task.options[0].label: «Лише бажання.»
findings.description: The explanation presents a specific time as a necessary property of plans and makes desire and planning mutually exclusive. Plans need not have a fixed date, and querer can express intention or determination. The sentence communicates wanting to travel without establishing whether arrangements exist.
findings.suggestion: Ask «Що прямо виражає це речення?» and label a «Бажання поїхати до Мадрида.». Describe the examples specifically: «Quiero…» expresses desire; «El sábado voy…» presents an action as planned for Saturday. Remove the general requirement that a plan have a specific time.

items.reviewerAnswer: a is closest: the sentence expresses a wish to travel to Madrid and specifies no day. It does not establish whether a plan also exists.
items.notes: The definite defect is the categorical explanation. The speaker's actual planning status remains unspecified.
